title: Update README with built environments and functionality inventory
objective: Update the project README/docs to list the environments and functionality built in this repository beyond upstream/base SPEAR. Include available environment/map names and Unreal content paths where known, validation status/caveats, and user-facing commands/workflows. Cover at least: cafeteria_500sqft_v2 and cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark, infinigen_indoors_0000, one_bed_apartment, college_classroom, flashlight live teleop including realistic_live_flashlight and realistic_live_flashlight_2x, Rerun stream, orbit collection/render workflow, flythrough/video helpers, Infinigen import/export/cook workflow, fixed exposure/scene-light scaling/indirect lighting controls, profile-driven flashlight settings, dark cafeteria orbit validation. Avoid overstating visual/runtime validation: note the headless DISPLAY/WAYLAND live validation blocker and pending visual checks where applicable. Prefer updating root README.md if present plus any concise cross-reference in docs/running_our_example_applications.md if needed. Do not commit.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket listing docs changed, inventory coverage, validation/checks run, and any remaining documentation gaps.
definition_of_done: README/docs include a clear inventory of built environments and functionality, with commands/paths and validation caveats, without claiming unvalidated runtime behavior succeeded.
